# Sun Moon Suites – Hotel in Sector 117, Noida

> Sun Moon Suites is a 30-room boutique hotel located at GT-20, Sector 117, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201316, India. Just 2 minutes from Tivoli Lotus Court Banquet and 5 minutes from Medanta Hospital Noida, Sector 76 Metro Station, and Spectrum Metro Mall, offering zero-commission direct room bookings, elevator access across 3 floors, free high-speed Wi-Fi, 100% power backup, 24x7 front desk service, and free on-site parking.
